payload.name: Context-dependent signaling in action control
payload.fact: Partial repetition costs in sequential two-choice tasks are modulated by display set size, suggesting that signaling heuristics incorporate context information to adapt response strategies.

provenance.title: Signaling as a context-dependent strategy in action control
provenance.quote_or_locus: These results suggest that signaling incorporates context information to adapt the usage of stimulus information for response strategies in accordance with the environment
